dedupe_keys.name: sig montevideo geoservicios ogc csw wms and wfs services of the intendencia de montevideo

description: The Intendencia de Montevideo publishes its geographic information as web services following Open Geospatial Consortium standards. The geoservices page read on 2026-09-28 describes a Catalogue Service for the Web (CSW) for searching data by words or coordinates, Web Map Services (WMS) for viewing and querying georeferenced layers as images from the web or desktop GIS, and Web Feature Services (WFS) for downloading geographic features in GML; services can be searched by text or by theme, including base cartography, land cover, geodetic data, aerial photos, housing, cadastral and census information, road and transport information, land-use planning, commercial permits, municipal and public services and zonings. Coverage is the department of Montevideo. Access is free through standard GIS clients; the licence is not stated on the page read. Caveats: layer lists and update dates must be read from the catalogue, which was not queried. It supports road and transport network models and hazard exposure studies of Montevideo, and city digital twins. Related records: data-montevideo-cadastral-parcels-land-use-plan and data-montevideo-approved-building-permits are single datasets from the same city.
